health_signals.name: circuit.open.rate
health_signals.description: Rate of circuit transitions to open state.

health_signals.name: fallback.activation.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of fallback or degraded-mode activation when the circuit opens.

health_signals.name: dependency.error.rate
health_signals.description: Downstream failure rate that should correlate with circuit activation.

gaps: Missing circuit state visibility makes degraded behavior hard to distinguish from total outage.
Dependency injection itself is not a runtime health signal; monitor the injected collaborators instead.

health_signals.name: event_store.append.latency
health_signals.description: Latency for appending new events to the store or stream.

health_signals.name: projection.lag
health_signals.description: Delay between event append and read-model projection completion.

health_signals.name: replay.duration
health_signals.description: Time required to rebuild aggregate state from historical events.

gaps: Missing projection lag or replay duration metrics hides read-side staleness and recovery cost.

health_signals.name: readiness.failure.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of failed readiness checks that would remove the instance from service.

health_signals.name: liveness.failure.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of failed liveness checks that would trigger restart behavior.

health_signals.name: health_check.latency
health_signals.description: Time taken to execute health probes, especially if they touch dependencies.

gaps: Combining dependency health into liveness without visibility can trigger cascading restart loops.

health_signals.name: adapter.error.rate
health_signals.description: Error rate per adapter boundary to expose which edge of the hexagon is failing.

health_signals.name: adapter.latency
health_signals.description: Latency per port or adapter boundary to surface slow infrastructure interactions.

gaps: If ports and adapters are not measured separately, infrastructure regressions look like generic application failures.

health_signals.name: validation.failure.rate
health_signals.description: Rate of rejected requests or payloads due to schema or contract violations.

health_signals.name: malformed_input.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of malformed or incomplete external inputs hitting the boundary.

gaps: Without validation rejection metrics, abuse and client integration failures are easy to miss.

health_signals.name: outbox.pending.count
health_signals.description: Number of unpublished outbox rows waiting to be delivered.

health_signals.name: outbox.max_age
health_signals.description: Age of the oldest unpublished outbox row.

health_signals.name: outbox.publish.failure.rate
health_signals.description: Failure rate for the background publisher draining the outbox.

gaps: Without lag and stale-age monitoring, dual-write protection exists but delivery failure is invisible.

health_signals.name: repository.error.rate
health_signals.description: Failure rate of repository operations, grouped by repository or aggregate boundary.

health_signals.name: repository.latency
health_signals.description: Latency distribution for repository operations that cross a persistence boundary.

health_signals.name: repository.slow_query.rate
health_signals.description: Rate of repository calls crossing slow-query or saturation thresholds.

gaps: If repository calls are not visible separately from application logic, persistence regressions are hard to isolate.

health_signals.name: retry.attempts
health_signals.description: Distribution of retry attempts before success or terminal failure.

health_signals.name: retry.exhausted.rate
health_signals.description: Rate at which retries are exhausted without recovery.

health_signals.name: downstream.retryable_error.rate
health_signals.description: Rate of retryable downstream failures that trigger the retry path.

gaps: If retries are invisible, transient downstream instability can silently consume latency budgets.

health_signals.name: authorization.denied.rate
health_signals.description: Rate of requests denied by route guards or authorization middleware.

health_signals.name: route_guard.error.rate
health_signals.description: Failures inside guard logic that can block or misroute requests.

gaps: Missing deny-rate and guard-error metrics makes it hard to distinguish policy enforcement from auth regressions.

health_signals.name: route.dispatch.latency
health_signals.description: End-to-end dispatch latency across the routing layer.

health_signals.name: route.not_found.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of unmatched requests returning 404 or equivalent dispatch misses.

gaps: Missing route-level latency and not-found metrics hides contract drift and traffic shape changes.

health_signals.name: structured_log.error.rate
health_signals.description: Error log rate with structured context preserved for aggregation.

health_signals.name: missing_log_context.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of logs missing expected request, trace, or correlation identifiers.

gaps: If structured context is inconsistent, downstream monitoring and incident triage quality degrades quickly.

health_signals.name: timeout.rate
health_signals.description: Rate of requests, jobs, or downstream calls that terminate due to timeout.

health_signals.name: timeout.cancellation.rate
health_signals.description: Frequency of successful cancellation or cleanup when a timeout occurs.

health_signals.name: downstream.timeout.rate
health_signals.description: Timeout rate for specific external calls or slow internal boundaries.

gaps: Timeout handling without timeout metrics hides latency collapse until users experience hard failures.
